title: Responsive Image Article
prompt: Use picture or srcset/sizes to provide more than one suitable image resource and a fallback img.
objective: Use an img fallback and at least one valid source/candidate declaration.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: picture, srcset, sizes.
hints: The referenced files must exist in your project. Keep alt on the img fallback.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.answer:
A Changing Landscape

Using responsive image sources helps the browser select an appropriate asset for the screen.
solution.explanation: One complete example is shown above. Reference approach: The referenced files must exist in your project. Keep alt on the img fallback. Required structural evidence: <picture>, <source, srcset=, sizes=, <img.
solution.expected_result: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: picture, srcset, sizes.
